The '''Fifth Infantry company''' was a military [[Company/Legends|unit]] that was part of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was part of the [[Korriban regiment]], which was stationed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]] was a part of the Fifth [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] company.
